quoting-app-for-tradies.intro: Finding the right quoting app can save you hours and protect your margins. We tested the top apps for Australian tradies on what actually matters on site: how fast you can build a quote, if it pulls live prices from Australian suppliers, and how easily you can get paid. We also looked at pricing models and proper GST handling. For most sole traders and small crews, QuoteMate is the best quoting app for Australian tradies thanks to its AI-assisted quoting and flat-rate pricing. The rest of the shortlist suits bigger crews or more specific needs.

sections.heading: What makes the best quoting app for Australian tradies
sections.body: The best app gets the details right for Australian tradies. First, speed. You need to build and send a quote while you're still on site, not spend your evening on admin. Second, price accuracy. The app must pull real-time prices from Australian suppliers, because using last month's price list costs you money. Third, the pricing model. Per-user fees, like Tradify's $48/user/mo, get expensive fast if you have a subbie or an apprentice. A flat monthly fee is predictable. Finally, it must handle GST and ABNs correctly and let you take payment on the spot. A 3% card fee is better than waiting 30 days to get paid.

sections.heading: The rest of the shortlist
sections.body: While QuoteMate is our top pick for quoting speed, other tools are better for specific jobs. Tradify is built for managing small crews with its timesheet and job dispatch features. ServiceM8 is a solid choice for teams running entirely on iPhones who need detailed digital job cards and forms. If you're a plumber or sparkie needing detailed project costing, Fergus is designed for you. For builders working from architectural plans, Buildxact is the specialised tool for take-offs and estimates. Quotient is a simple online quote builder, but it’s not tradie-focused and its pricing is in US dollars, which is a hassle with currency conversion and GST.

faqs.question: What's the best free quoting app for Australian tradies?
faqs.answer: QuoteMate offers the best free plan for tradies starting out. It lets you create professional quotes with your logo and handles GST automatically. ServiceM8 also has a free tier, but it's limited to 20 jobs per month. For a proper, unlimited free option that helps you price correctly from day one, QuoteMate is the clear choice.

faqs.question: Why not just use Xero or MYOB for quoting?
faqs.answer: Xero and MYOB are for accounting, not for quoting. They can create a basic invoice, but they can't build a detailed materials list with live supplier pricing. They're designed for your bookkeeper, not for you on site. A proper quoting app helps you win the work and price it profitably, then syncs the final invoice to Xero.

faqs.question: Which quoting app is cheapest for a sole trader?
faqs.answer: For a solo operator, QuoteMate's Pro plan at $49/month is the best value. While Tradify is $48/month, it's a per-user cost that bites you as soon as you hire someone. QuoteMate is a flat fee for the whole business. ServiceM8 starts at $29/month but scales up with job volume. QuoteMate’s price includes the AI features and live supplier data that prevent under-quoting.

invoicing-app-for-tradies.intro: Picking an invoicing app is about more than just sending a PDF. For a tradie, it’s about speed on site, accurate pricing, and getting paid faster. We judged the best apps on how quickly they build a quote, whether they use live prices from Australian suppliers, their GST handling, and how they take payment. The verdict: QuoteMate is the best invoicing app for most Australian tradies because it’s built for quoting first. But if you need full accounting or have simpler needs, one of the others on our shortlist might suit you better.

sections.heading: What makes the best invoicing app for Australian tradies
sections.body: The best app gets the details right for Australian tradies. It needs to be fast on your phone, not just on a laptop in the office. It should pull live material prices from Australian suppliers, so your quote is accurate today, not last month. The pricing model should be simple—a flat fee, not a per-user cost that punishes you for growing your crew. It must handle GST and ABNs correctly without you thinking about it. And finally, it needs to help you get paid on the spot. An app with integrated tap-to-pay means you're not chasing invoices for weeks.

sections.heading: The rest of the shortlist
sections.body: If your main job is accounting, Xero and MYOB are the industry standards. They handle your BAS and payroll properly but can be slower for on-site quoting. QuickBooks is another strong accounting option with unlimited invoices on its plans. For sole traders who just need simple invoicing and BAS tracking, Rounded is a good choice built specifically for that purpose. If you just want a basic, cross-industry invoicing tool without the trade-specific features, Invoice2go is a simple and cheap way to get started. Each is a solid tool, just built for a different job.

faqs.question: What's the best free invoicing app for Australian tradies?
faqs.answer: QuoteMate is the best free option. Its free plan lets you create professional quotes and invoices using its core AI features for building line items. It's not a limited-time trial, so you can use it for as long as you need. This makes it a good way to get started without committing to a monthly fee while you're growing your business.

faqs.question: What's the cheapest paid invoicing app?
faqs.answer: For the lowest starting price, Invoice2go and MYOB both have plans from around $11 per month. Be aware that these entry-level plans often have limits on the number of clients, invoices, or features. Always check that the cheapest plan actually does what you need it to do before you sign up. The price isn't everything if the tool can't keep up.

faqs.question: Do I need a quoting app if I already use Xero or MYOB?
faqs.answer: Yes, they do different jobs. Xero and MYOB are for accounting—BAS, payroll, and end-of-year tax. A dedicated app like QuoteMate is for quoting—building accurate quotes fast with live supplier prices and getting paid on site. QuoteMate syncs with Xero, so you get the speed of a quoting tool and the power of a proper accounting system working together.

sections.heading: What makes the best job management software for Australian tradies
sections.body: The right software saves you time on site, not in an office. First, look for live pricing from Australian suppliers. Quoting with last month's prices from Reece or Tradelink costs you profit. Second, check the pricing model. sections.heading: The rest of the shortlist

Both AroFlo and simPRO are powerful but often come with setup fees and are overkill for smaller outfits. They suit businesses with dedicated office staff to run the system.

faqs.question: What's the best free job management software for tradies?
faqs.answer: QuoteMate has a permanent free plan that covers quoting and invoicing, not just a limited trial. It’s powerful enough for many sole traders starting out. ServiceM8 also has a free tier, but it has tighter limits on the number of jobs you can manage per month. Most other platforms only offer a 14-day trial.

faqs.question: Which software is cheapest for a small crew?
faqs.answer: QuoteMate's Pro plan is a flat $49 per month for your whole business, which makes it the cheapest option if you have more than one person. Other tools like Tradify start at $48 but charge per user, so a two-person team costs $96. Always check if the price is a flat rate or per user.

faqs.question: Do I still need this if I use Xero or MYOB?
faqs.answer: Yes. Xero and MYOB are for accounting after the work is done. Job management software is for running the actual job: quoting, ordering materials, and getting paid on site. Good software like QuoteMate syncs your invoices to Xero automatically, which saves you entering them twice and keeps your bookkeeper happy.
